messages:
maria: heads up — PR 43218 is ready for merge but i need runtime + security sanity checks before i schedule the merge window. small change: routing fallback priority + a config tweak for kms timeouts. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/43218

jules: i can take runtime — will run the perf smoke and validate kv cache behavior. planning to run: `./tools/perf/smoke.sh --profile=short` and a quick memory check.

maria: thanks jules. can you call out any perf regressions here in thread? trying to avoid a canary rollback.

jules: quick note — on my laptop it looks fine, but i'll run on a dedicated canary node (p3-small) and post numbers. should have something in ~30m.

ci-bot: CI status — PR 43218: unit ✅, integration ✅, canary-deploy: queued. (build 7891)

oliver: cc infra — i'm happy to review the infra touchpoints. did you add the new config to the secrets manifest or is it runtime-only? i want to ensure we don't change infra-level defaults.

maria: infra change is optional — it's a runtime flag that will default to existing behavior unless KMS is enabled explicitly. i added a short note in the PR description under 'operational impact'.

sam: i'll take security review. quick heads up: if the KMS timeout is surfaced in a new config, add validation to block values < 500ms and document it in the runbook. also need a note for key rotation interactions.

maria: good call — i'll add the validation and update the runbook.

jules: can confirm basic perf sanity on canary: latency p50 +3ms, p95 +12ms on a short run. no KV cache thrashing observed. posting logs in the PR.

sam: security quick-check done: config validation + runbook note LGTM. no secrets leakage. :thumbsup:

oliver: infra ack — no infra changes required, but pls include a short rollback/feature-flag plan in the PR body so ops can flip if needed.

maria: added rollback steps and a feature flag toggle in PR description. scheduling merge for 2025-06-05 22:00 UTC unless anyone objects.

jules: fine for me. i'll monitor canary for first hour post-merge.

sam: ok for security.

maria: thanks team — merging after the slot unless anyone raises a blocker. :rocket:

ci-bot: deployment scheduled for 2025-06-05T22:00:00Z (canary group: runtime-canary-3).
